summary.zh: 把有限输入分给多台机器，避免一边吃撑、一边断粮。
summary.en: Divide limited input among machines without starving one branch.

rules.zh: 玩家用分流器把一条输入接到多个消费者。每台机器有不同消耗速度，某个出口积压会改变实际分配；以稳定开工率而非建筑数量判断成功。
rules.en: Players split one input among consumers with different consumption rates. Blocked exits change actual distribution; sustained operation matters more than machine count.

decisions.zh: 平均分配简单，但需求不等时会浪费供给。
decisions.en: Equal distribution is simple but mismatched demand can waste supply.

decisions.zh: 串联喂料占地小，却需要等待前端缓冲填满。
decisions.en: A manifold is compact but needs its upstream buffers to fill.

effect.zh: 差异越大，平均分流越不够用，需要优先级或多级分配。
effect.en: Larger differences make equal splits insufficient and reward priorities or staged division.

effect.zh: 大缓冲平滑短时波动，也拉长稳定运行前的等待。
effect.en: Larger buffers smooth interruptions but delay steady-state behavior.

contrast.zh: 两个出口加优先级便于处理抢料；三个出口使三分支网络更直接。
contrast.en: Two outputs with priority help allocate contested supply; three outputs make three-way layouts straightforward.

combination.zh: 让自动厨房同时处理食堂和高价订单，玩家调节分流优先级，承受不同订单的超时成本。
combination.en: Build an automated kitchen that divides ingredients between a canteen and premium orders with different late penalties.

setup.zh: 同一条带每轮送来6块矿，两台机器分别需要2块和4块。
setup.en: A belt supplies six ore per round; two machines need two and four respectively.

action.zh: 你把支路分配改成约1比2，避免机械地对半分。
action.en: Adjust the split toward one-to-two instead of dividing evenly.

result.zh: 两台机器都能连续工作，前端积压与后端缺料同时减少。
result.en: Both machines run continuously, reducing both upstream queues and downstream starvation.

next.zh: 新增机器后重新算需求，再调整支路。
next.en: Recalculate demand and branches when adding another machine.

firstStep.zh: 做一个固定供给源、两个不同消耗速度的接收器和可调分流器，显示开工率。
firstStep.en: Use one fixed source, two consumers with different rates and an adjustable splitter, displaying uptime.

pitfall.zh: 不要先加入几十种配方；两种不同需求已经能检验比例是否影响产出。
pitfall.en: Do not start with dozens of recipes; two different demands can reveal whether allocation matters.

test.zh: 玩家看到“一台堆料、一台停机”时，是否会改比例，而非只增加输入？
test.en: When one machine queues and another stalls, do players change allocation rather than simply add input?
